objective: Improve a deployable <=100 MB single-sample Student using subject-disjoint Train-only evidence.

embargo.policy: Exclude these rows from both development training and evaluation. They are the exhausted P86-v1 permanent validation set.
embargo.kaggle_test_policy: Do not read Test predictions, pseudo-labels, submissions, leaderboard scores, or Test-derived thresholds.

development.name: fresh_balanced_holdout_a
development.rationale: These subjects were P86-v1 training subjects, never members of its repeatedly inspected six-subject proxy. The set was selected from labels and counts before P86-v2 predictions were read; it covers all 40 classes.

confirmation.name: sealed_holdout_b
confirmation.policy: Do not evaluate candidate predictions on this fold until the candidate mechanism, architecture, loss, and epoch budget are frozen. Retrain from the generic pretrained initialization with this fold excluded.
